scope: Retail SBL/ROM entry reachability through Case, without temple application

bootLayers.romHelpers: ROM table entries0x0200FF0C..0x0200FF5C, called by Apollo code, not established serial commands. Actual2.3.0.24 app contains table at0x00791758.
bootLayers.sbl: NVM0x00400000..0x0040FFFF; no authenticated retail SBL image in inspected official OTA corpus.
bootLayers.evenBootloader: 0x00410000; actual2.3.0.24 artifact and native functions directly analyzed.
bootLayers.application: 0x00438000; application UART2 configuration is not proof of pre-application SBL configuration.

evenBootloader23024.finding: Flag0x007FE000==0x55555555 selects staged file ota/s200_firmware_ota.bin; reviewed manager/event loop and DFU task expose no external recovery-command listener. No claim of complete bootloader or SBL listener absence.

entryCandidates.requires: Retail wired UART enabled/module2, exact INFO0 RX44/TX42 mux/framing, nonzero timeout and actual reset/power reachability.
entryCandidates.caseCapability: Can route and send UART2-compatible bytes; cannot establish or change retail provisioning without a verified temple endpoint.

entryCandidates.requires: INFOC0x400C2250 enable, GPIO number and polarity; GPIO physically driven across reset.
entryCandidates.caseCapability: No verified connection from Case route to the configured override or Apollo nRESET. Pogo UART application pins42/44 alone are insufficient.

entryCandidates.requires: INFO0 offset0x68 master nibble6, triggerGPIO/polarity, wired recovery enable and correct interface configuration.
entryCandidates.caseCapability: Retail fields and Case-to-trigger wiring unknown.

entryCandidates.requires: Apollo code writes0xAFD1363A to OTAPOINTER then requests POI; revision restrictions apply.
entryCandidates.caseCapability: Case SRAM runs on STM32 and cannot perform these Apollo register writes through an unresponsive temple.

entryCandidates.requires: Actual retail SBL/ROM policy and applicable provisioning.
entryCandidates.caseCapability: Missing replies do not establish boot failure state or fallback. Deliberate image corruption excluded.

caseResetTrace.behavior: Acquires2510 route, selects side, drivesGPIO pulse train and restores charging profile. It can emit without an application reply.
caseResetTrace.boundary: Emission does not independently prove Apollo reset, electrical delivery or override assertion. It is not a demonstrated SBL-entry command.
caseResetTrace.previousMacOnlyProbe: Qualified HELLO after waveform had no response; not repeated on unchanged iPhone pair.

romReadHelper.finding: Callable helper is present in app helper table; no verified stock serial invocation. It does not create an out-of-band read protocol.

hardwareTest: None. No UART traffic, GPIO drive, reset, firmware/INFO/OTP changes, or corruption test.
limitations: Chip capability definitions are not retail provisioned values.
SBL and ROM implementation bytes were not acquired.
Working iPhone provisioning cannot be inferred from application configuration or transferred to Mac right.
